name: ten1010-io
description: AI-powered QA automation and Git workflow toolkit for Claude Code.

plugins.name: ten-toolkit
plugins.description: AI-powered QA automation and Git workflow toolkit. /aqa-inspect runs end-to-end QA (generate test cases from a Figma design or live-URL exploration → execute → results.csv + HTML report), /aqa-jira files Jira tickets from failed QA results behind a human gate, /create-pr creates pull requests, /merge-check does dry-run merge validation.

plugins.name: java-team
plugins.description: Ten 개발3팀(JAVA팀) 공용 스킬. /java-team:meeting-prep 은 지난 회의 이후의 Jira·GitHub·Slack 업무공유 내역을 모아 월(간단 공유)·수(상세 리뷰) 회의 형식으로 정리하고, 검토 후 Confluence 회의 페이지의 본인 섹션에 반영한다.
